_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd (MIT).
name: Counter-Strike 2
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Valve's tactical shooter. Installs the dedicated server with SteamCMD and keeps it updated, with game mode, map and Workshop collection settings, and Metamod:Source and CounterStrikeSharp for plugins.
startup: gi=game/csgo/gameinfo.gi; mm='Game csgo/addons/metamod // added by Raptor (Metamod:Source)'; vdf=game/csgo/addons/metamod/counterstrikesharp.vdf; if [ "{{METAMOD}}" = 1 ] || [ "{{COUNTERSTRIKESHARP}}" = 1 ]; then if [ ! -f game/csgo/addons/metamod/bin/linuxsteamrt64/metamod.2.cs2.so ]; then echo "Metamod:Source isn't installed yet: reinstall the server to install it."; elif ! grep -q 'csgo/addons/metamod' "$gi"; then sed -i "/Game_LowViolence/a $mm" "$gi"; grep -q 'csgo/addons/metamod' "$gi" || echo "gameinfo.gi has no Game_LowViolence line, so Metamod:Source can't be loaded."; fi; else sed -i '/added by Raptor (Metamod:Source)/d' "$gi"; fi; if [ "{{COUNTERSTRIKESHARP}}" = 1 ]; then [ ! -f "$vdf.off" ] || mv -f "$vdf.off" "$vdf"; elif [ -f game/csgo/addons/counterstrikesharp/.raptor ] && [ -f "$vdf" ]; then mv -f "$vdf" "$vdf.off"; fi; LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$HOME/game/bin/linuxsteamrt64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH" ./game/bin/linuxsteamrt64/cs2 -dedicated $([ "{{VAC_ENABLED}}" = 1 ] || echo -insecure) $([ "{{RCON_ENABLED}}" = 1 ] && echo -usercon) -ip 0.0.0.0 -port {{SERVER_PORT}} -tv_port {{TV_PORT}} -maxplayers {{MAX_PLAYERS}} +game_type {{GAME_TYPE}} +game_mode {{GAME_MODE}} +map {{SRCDS_MAP}} +hostname "{{SERVER_NAME}}" +sv_password "{{SERVER_PASSWORD}}" +rcon_password "{{RCON_PASSWORD}}" ${STEAM_GSLT:++sv_setsteamaccount $STEAM_GSLT} ${WORKSHOP_COLLECTION:++host_workshop_collection $WORKSHOP_COLLECTION}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Counter-Strike 2. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 730)
# with SteamCMD, signed in anonymously, then Metamod:Source and
# CounterStrikeSharp when they're on. Configs, maps and plugins are kept.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-730}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

echo "Installed Counter-Strike 2 build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

# Metamod:Source and CounterStrikeSharp, when turned on: the newest builds
# (or the ones pinned) unpacked into game/csgo/addons. What the owner set up
# is kept: metaplugins.ini, CounterStrikeSharp's configs and plugins. The
# startup adds Metamod to gameinfo.gi at every start, since game updates
# replace that file.
addons=game/csgo/addons
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
# CounterStrikeSharp runs on Metamod, so it brings Metamod with it.
if [ "${METAMOD:-0}" = 1 ] || [ "${COUNTERSTRIKESHARP:-0}" = 1 ]; then
    rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work/mms" "$addons"
    mms=https://mms.alliedmods.net/mmsdrop/2.0
    want=${METAMOD_VERSION:-latest}
    if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
        file=$(curl -fsS --retry 3 "$mms/mmsource-latest-linux") || fail "AlliedModders' downloads can't be reached right now, so Metamod:Source wasn't installed. Reinstall to try again."
    else
        file=$(curl -fsS --retry 3 "$mms/" | grep -oE "mmsource-[0-9.]+-git${want}-linux\.tar\.gz" | head -n 1) || true
        [ -n "$file" ] || fail "Metamod:Source has no build $want. Set Metamod version to latest or a build number from mms.alliedmods.net, then reinstall."
    fi
    [[ $file =~ ^mmsource-[0-9.]+-git[0-9]+-linux\.tar\.gz$ ]] || fail "AlliedModders' downloads answered something unexpected, so Metamod:Source wasn't installed. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "Downloading Metamod:Source (${file%-linux.tar.gz})"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$work/mms.tar.gz" "$mms/$file" || fail "The Metamod:Source download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    tar -xzf "$work/mms.tar.gz" -C "$work/mms" --no-same-owner
    [ -f "$work/mms/addons/metamod/bin/linuxsteamrt64/metamod.2.cs2.so" ] || fail "Metamod:Source build $file has no Counter-Strike 2 files. Choose another Metamod version, then reinstall."
    [ ! -f "$addons/metamod/metaplugins.ini" ] || rm -f "$work/mms/addons/metamod/metaplugins.ini"
    cp -rf "$work/mms/addons/." "$addons/"
    echo "Installed Metamod:Source ${file#mmsource-}" | sed 's/-linux\.tar\.gz$//'
fi
if [ "${COUNTERSTRIKESHARP:-0}" = 1 ]; then
    repo=roflmuffin/CounterStrikeSharp
    want=${CSS_VERSION:-latest}
    [ "$want" = latest ] || want="v${want#v}"
    tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want") || fail "CounterStrikeSharp has no release $want. Set CounterStrikeSharp version to latest or a release such as 1.0.380, then reinstall."
    # The build with .NET in it, so the runtime always matches the release.
    asset="counterstrikesharp-with-runtime-linux-${tag#v}.zip"
    gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag" | awk -v a="$asset" '$1 == a && $2 ~ /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/ { f = 1 } END { exit !f }' || fail "CounterStrikeSharp $tag has no $asset with a checksum, so it wasn't installed."
    echo "Downloading CounterStrikeSharp $tag"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$work/css.zip" || fail "The CounterStrikeSharp download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    mkdir -p "$work/css" && unzip -qo "$work/css.zip" -d "$work/css"
    [ -f "$work/css/addons/metamod/counterstrikesharp.vdf" ] || fail "CounterStrikeSharp $tag isn't laid out as expected, so it wasn't installed."
    # Its own files are replaced whole (an old .NET left behind breaks it);
    # configs, plugins and shared libraries stay.
    rm -rf "$addons/counterstrikesharp/api" "$addons/counterstrikesharp/bin" "$addons/counterstrikesharp/dotnet"
    cp -rf "$work/css/addons/." "$addons/"
    rm -f "$addons/metamod/counterstrikesharp.vdf.off"
    # Raptor installed it, so turning it off may stop it loading.
    echo "$tag" > "$addons/counterstrikesharp/.raptor"
    echo "Installed CounterStrikeSharp $tag"
fi

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with, or empty for none.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts on, such as de_dust2 or de_mirage.

variables.name: Game type
variables.description: With Game mode, what's played: 0 and 1 is Competitive, 0 and 0 Casual, 0 and 2 Wingman, 1 and 2 Deathmatch, 1 and 0 Arms Race.

variables.name: Game mode
variables.description: With Game type, what's played: see Game type.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: The most players on the server at once.

variables.name: Game server token
variables.description: A Game Server Login Token from Steam's game server account page (app 730), which public servers need to be listed. Empty, the server is only joinable by address.

variables.name: Workshop collection
variables.description: The ID of a Steam Workshop map collection to host, or empty for none.

variables.name: Metamod:Source
variables.description: Install Metamod:Source, which server plugins load through, and load it at every start. Reinstall after turning it on; turned off, it stops loading at the next start.

variables.name: Metamod version
variables.description: The Metamod:Source build to install, such as 1491, or latest for the newest. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: CounterStrikeSharp
variables.description: Install CounterStrikeSharp, which runs C# plugins from addons/counterstrikesharp/plugins, with Metamod:Source. Reinstall after turning it on; turned off, it stops loading at the next start.

variables.name: CounterStrikeSharp version
variables.description: The CounterStrikeSharp release to install, such as 1.0.380, or latest for the newest. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: VAC
variables.description: Valve Anti-Cheat. Off, the server runs insecure and isn't listed.

variables.name: RCON
variables.description: Let RCON tools connect, with the RCON password.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: The password RCON tools and in-game rcon use.

variables.name: SourceTV port
variables.description: The port for SourceTV spectators, when tv_enable is on. Add it as an allocation.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Validate files
variables.description: Check every game file against Steam when installing or updating, which repairs damaged files but takes longer.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, such as staging, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.
